paragraphs: In Nedarim 29b, Rabbi Avin and Rav Yitzchak Berabbi sat before Rabbi Yirmiyah while Rabbi Yirmiyah was dozing, etc. But without doubt the name should read Rav Yitzchak bar Yosef; see his entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Nedarim paragraph expressly says Rabbi Yirmiyah was dozing. The proposed bar Yosef reading is Hyman’s confident correction.

The checked Nedarim 29b passage names Rabbi Avin and Rav Yitzchak Berabbi before Rabbi Yirmiyah and explicitly repeats Rabbi Yirmiyah as the one dozing. Hyman’s “without doubt it should read Rav Yitzchak bar Yosef” remains his emphatic emendation; the witness itself retains Berabbi. The cross-reference does not establish an identity binding.
